description: Built for Shopify criteria (sample subset). Re-check https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/launch/built-for-shopify/requirements and the BFS changelog before each project.

reviewers.label: Server
reviewers.focus: Env vars and secrets, migrations, queues, retry, timeouts, logging, monitoring, rate limits, supported API version
reviewers.evidence: Config, migrations, runtime logs, failure-test output

reviewers.label: Backend
reviewers.focus: OAuth, session/ID token, access scopes, GraphQL Admin API, webhook HMAC + idempotency, privacy webhooks, billing, per-shop data isolation
reviewers.evidence: Code lines, API test output, sample webhooks

reviewers.label: Frontend
reviewers.focus: App Bridge, Polaris web components, navigation, save bar, error messages, mobile, contrast, loading states, BFS design rules
reviewers.evidence: Code lines, screenshots, Playwright output, Web Vitals

rules.title: Embedded in admin with the latest App Bridge, uses ID token
No extra sign-up or login after install
Storefront UI uses a theme app extension
No Asset API edits to theme files (except listed exceptions)
Forms use the Contextual Save Bar
Home page shows whether the app is working and useful metrics
Errors are red, next to the related field, and do not auto-dismiss
No promises about revenue or SEO ranking in the UI
AI features do not use the Sidekick icon or magic-purple colours
Analytics-category apps collect storefront events with Web Pixel
LCP <= 2.5s, CLS <= 0.1, INP <= 200ms at p75, >= 100 samples in 28 days
Storefront Lighthouse score does not drop more than 10 points
>= 50 net installs from paid shops and >= 5 reviews
AI API keys and shop access tokens only on the server
Every business table has shop_id and every query filters by it
AI-proposed store writes require merchant approval
Each model call logs prompt version, tokens, latency and errors; per-shop daily cost cap
Mandatory privacy webhooks: customers/data_request, customers/redact, shop/redact
